ideas.title: The Impact of the Federal Funds Freeze on Minnesota's Child Care Assistance Program
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the federal funds freeze on child care providers and low-income families in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: The human impact of the freeze
questions: How many child care providers have been affected by the freeze?
What are the potential long-term consequences for low-income families?
ideas.insight: The freeze may have a disproportionate impact on low-income families and child care providers, and further investigation is needed to determine the full extent of the effects.
